faqs.q: Sec. 62-72. - Prohibited use of skateboards, in-line skates, and similar devices.
faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person to use skateboards, in-line skates, or similar
               devices on public or private property which is posted to prohibit any person from
               entering or remaining upon that property while utilizing skateboards, in-line skates,
               or similar devices.
(b)
The owner of private property is authorized to post or cause to be posted signs which
               give notice of the prohibition of the use of skateboards, in-line skates, or similar
               devices referenced in subsection (a). Such posting shall be deemed to authorize, without
               further action of the owner, enforcement of this section.
(
Ord. No. 4044, § 1, 12-18-2006
)
